title: Charges Written into Every Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease at Booking
content:
**Schedule of contract charges — Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

These figures are written into every Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease when it is booked and are the same in all six tiers, Kestrel Lease Tier 5 through Kestrel Lease Tier 1+.

**Excess mileage rate written into the lease, by vehicle class**

| Vehicle class | Sedan | SUV | Truck | Electric |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rate per mile | $0.20 | $0.25 | $0.25 | $0.20 |

The lease records the rate for its vehicle's class as the lease's excess mileage rate.

**Fees and purchase-option terms**

| Item | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Disposition fee written into the lease | $395 |
| Purchase option fee written into the lease | $350 |
| Fee added to the purchase price when a Kestrel franchised dealer buys the vehicle on the lessee's behalf | $300 |
| Calendar days after the quote date through which a purchase or termination quote is honoured | 10 |
| Calendar days after the maturity date (or the extended maturity) during which the maturity purchase price still applies | 30 |

**Notes on the schedule**

- The disposition fee and the purchase option fee recorded on an individual lease are the amounts that lease carries; the figures above are what is written at booking.
- Hypothetical illustration: an SUV lease records an excess mileage rate of $0.25 per mile and a disposition fee of $395; a sedan lease records $0.20 per mile and the same $395.
